user_prompt: Create a parser for schema.txt file using sqlglot that will be later on used to visualize column lineage of the sql tables and views. Create a good parsser that will support visualization later on, but no visualization yet - backend structures only for now.

spec.description: A backend library that parses a SQL schema file (DDL + views) with sqlglot, builds typed data-models for every table/column/view, resolves column-level lineage across views, and exposes a catalog API ready for a visualization layer. The default dialect is None (sqlglot generic), NOT the unsupported "ansi" string, fixing the sqlglot 30.8.0 incompatibility identified by the tester.

files.description: All custom exception types for the sql_lineage package. Kept in their own file so every other module can import them without creating cycles.

components.name: SchemaParseError
components.description: Base exception for all errors raised by sql_lineage. Inherits from Exception. Stores an optional `detail` string.

methods.name: __str__
methods.notes: Returns '{message} – {detail}' when detail is non-empty, else message.

components.name: UnresolvedReferenceError
components.description: Raised when a column or table reference inside a view cannot be matched to a known table/column. Subclass of SchemaParseError.
notes: Sets detail=context; message = f'Unresolved reference: {ref}'

components.name: CircularDependencyError
components.description: Raised when a cycle is detected in the view dependency graph. Subclass of SchemaParseError.

attributes.name: cycle
attributes.description: Ordered list of names forming the cycle

notes: message = f'Circular dependency detected: {" -> ".join(cycle)}'

files.description: Single utility function that normalises SQL identifiers: strips ANSI double-quotes, MySQL back-ticks, T-SQL square brackets, then lowercases and strips surrounding whitespace.

components.name: normalize_name
components.description: Strip quoting characters (ANSI "", MySQL ``, T-SQL []) from a SQL identifier, then lowercase and strip whitespace. Returns the raw identifier unchanged (lowercased) when no quoting is present.
notes: signature: (name: str) -> str
Handles empty string gracefully (returns "").
Does NOT depend on dialect; stripping all three quoting styles is safe and dialect-agnostic.

files.description: Immutable (frozen) dataclasses and one mutable container that together form the complete in-memory representation of a parsed schema and its column-level lineage graph.

components.name: ColumnRef
components.description: Frozen dataclass. Uniquely identifies one column within the schema: (table_or_view_name, column_name). Both fields are already normalised (lowercase, unquoted).
notes: @dataclass(frozen=True)
Hashable; used as dict key and in sets.

components.name: ForeignKeyDef
components.description: Frozen dataclass. Represents one foreign-key constraint: from_table.from_col -> to_table.to_col.
notes: @dataclass(frozen=True)

components.name: TableDef
components.description: Frozen dataclass representing one CREATE TABLE statement: its name, ordered column list, primary-key column set, and foreign-key constraints.
notes: @dataclass(frozen=True)

components.name: ViewDef
components.description: Frozen dataclass representing one CREATE VIEW statement: its name, the original query text, the resolved output column list, and the set of table/view names it references (excluding CTE aliases).
notes: @dataclass(frozen=True)
output_columns may contain '*' when wildcard is unresolved at parse time.

components.name: LineageEdge
components.description: Frozen dataclass. A directed edge source_column -> target_column meaning the target column is derived from the source column.
notes: @dataclass(frozen=True)

components.name: SchemaGraph
components.description: Mutable container that holds the full parsed schema: a dict of tables, a dict of views, and a list of lineage edges. This is the central data structure passed between parser, resolver, and catalog.
notes: @dataclass
NOT frozen — resolver mutates edges in-place after the parser fills tables/views.

files.description: SchemaParser: reads a schema file (or SQL string), delegates to sqlglot for AST parsing, and populates a SchemaGraph with TableDef and ViewDef objects. Does NOT resolve column lineage — that is the resolver's job. IMPORTANT: default dialect is None, not 'ansi', to be compatible with sqlglot 30.8.0.

components.name: SchemaParser
components.description: Parses DDL SQL using sqlglot into a SchemaGraph. Handles CREATE TABLE (columns, PK inline/constraint, FK inline/constraint) and CREATE VIEW (SELECT AST, output columns, dependency table names). Ignores non-DDL statements silently.

attributes.name: dialect
attributes.description: sqlglot dialect string, e.g. 'postgres', 'mysql', 'tsql'. Defaults to None (sqlglot generic), which is valid in sqlglot 30.8.0. 'ansi' is NOT used as it is not a supported dialect name in that release.

attributes.name: _tables
attributes.description: Accumulated table definitions, reset per parse_statements call.

attributes.name: _views
attributes.description: Accumulated view definitions, reset per parse_statements call.

methods.name: __init__
notes: Stores dialect; does not call sqlglot yet.

methods.name: parse_file
notes: Reads file as UTF-8, delegates to parse_statements.

methods.name: parse_statements
notes: Calls sqlglot.parse(sql, dialect=self.dialect).
Iterates AST nodes; dispatches Create nodes to _parse_create_table or _parse_create_view.
Non-Create nodes and None nodes are silently skipped.
Wraps sqlglot errors in SchemaParseError.
Raises SchemaParseError on duplicate table or view names.
Returns a fresh SchemaGraph(tables=..., views=..., edges=[]).

methods.name: _parse_create_table
notes: Extracts table name via node.find(exp.Table).name.
Calls _extract_columns and _extract_constraints.
Raises SchemaParseError if name is missing.

methods.name: _parse_create_view
notes: Extracts view name via node.find(exp.Table).name.
Finds the SELECT expression (node.find(exp.Select)).
Calls _extract_view_output_columns and _extract_dependencies.
Raises SchemaParseError if name or SELECT is missing.
Stores query=node.sql(dialect=self.dialect).

methods.name: _extract_columns
notes: Iterates node.find_all(exp.ColumnDef); normalizes each column name.
Returns an empty tuple for tables with no column defs (e.g. CREATE TABLE ... AS SELECT).

methods.name: _extract_constraints
notes: Returns (primary_keys, foreign_keys).
Detects inline PrimaryKeyColumnConstraint per ColumnDef.
Detects standalone PrimaryKey constraint (possibly composite).
Detects inline ForeignKey per ColumnDef and standalone ForeignKey constraints.
All names are normalized.

methods.name: _extract_view_output_columns
notes: Maps each expression in select.expressions to an output name.
Star -> '*'.
Aliased -> normalize alias.
Column -> normalize column name.
Other expressions -> normalize alias if present else repr fallback.

methods.name: _extract_dependencies
notes: Collects all exp.Table nodes inside FROM and JOIN clauses.
Excludes names that match CTE aliases defined in the same query (WITH clause).
Returns normalized frozenset of table/view names.
Import sqlglot and sqlglot.expressions as exp at module level.
Use sqlglot.parse() (not sqlglot.transpile) to get AST nodes.
Never hard-code dialect='ansi'; always pass self.dialect which defaults to None.

files.description: LineageResolver: takes a fully populated SchemaGraph (tables + views, no edges yet) and resolves column-level lineage for every view. Mutates graph.edges in-place. Views are processed in topological order so that lineage from upstream views is available when resolving downstream ones.

components.name: LineageResolver
components.description: Resolves column-level lineage edges across all views in a SchemaGraph. Uses sqlglot to re-parse each view's stored query text to get a fresh AST for column-source analysis. The dialect must match the one used during parsing.

attributes.name: dialect
attributes.description: Must match the SchemaParser dialect. Defaults to None.

methods.name: resolve
notes: Topologically sorts views by their dependencies using _topo_sort_views.
Iterates sorted views and calls _resolve_view for each.
Detects cycles and raises CircularDependencyError.
Mutates graph.edges in-place; returns None.

methods.name: _topo_sort_views
notes: Kahn's algorithm over the view dependency sub-graph.
Raises CircularDependencyError if a cycle is found.
Tables are treated as roots (no sorting needed for them).

methods.name: _resolve_view
notes: Re-parses view.query via sqlglot.parse_one(view.query, dialect=self.dialect).
Finds the SELECT node.
Calls _build_alias_map to map alias -> canonical table/view name.
For each output expression calls _node_to_ref to find the source ColumnRef.
Pairs source ColumnRef with target ColumnRef(view.name, output_col_name).
Appends resulting LineageEdge objects to graph.edges.
Wildcard (*) columns: expands to all columns of referenced table if unambiguous, else stores a single edge with column='*'.

methods.name: _build_alias_map
methods.signature: (self, select: sqlglot.exp.Select, graph: SchemaGraph) -> dict[str, str]
notes: Iterates FROM and JOIN table references.
Maps alias (or table name when no alias) -> canonical name in graph.
Normalizes all names.

methods.name: _node_to_ref
methods.signature: (self, node: sqlglot.exp.Expression, alias_map: dict[str, str], graph: SchemaGraph) -> ColumnRef | None
notes: Handles exp.Column: qualifies with alias_map if table qualifier present, else tries to infer from single-table views.
Returns None when reference cannot be resolved (caller decides whether to raise or skip).
Normalizes all names.

methods.name: _output_column_name
notes: Returns alias if present, else column name for plain Column nodes, else '*' for Star nodes.
Normalizes result.
Does not raise UnresolvedReferenceError by default; ambiguous/unresolvable columns are skipped to keep the graph partial-but-valid.
Never passes dialect='ansi'; always uses self.dialect (default None).

files.description: SchemaCatalog: a read-only query interface built over a resolved SchemaGraph. Provides entity lookups and both direct and transitive upstream/downstream column lineage queries via BFS. Intended as the primary API for a visualization layer.

components.name: SchemaCatalog
components.description: Wraps a resolved SchemaGraph and pre-builds forward/backward adjacency indexes for O(1) direct-neighbor lookups and efficient BFS traversals.

methods.name: __init__
notes: Calls _build_indexes().

methods.name: _build_indexes
notes: Iterates graph.edges once.
Populates _downstream[edge.source].add(edge.target) and _upstream[edge.target].add(edge.source).

methods.name: get_table
notes: normalize_name(name); raises KeyError if not found.

methods.name: get_view
notes: normalize_name(name); raises KeyError if not found.

methods.name: all_tables
notes: Returns list(graph.tables.values()).

methods.name: all_views
notes: Returns list(graph.views.values()).

methods.name: upstream_columns
notes: Returns direct upstream set; empty set when col has no known sources.

methods.name: downstream_columns
notes: Returns direct downstream set; empty set when col has no known targets.

methods.name: transitive_upstream
notes: BFS from col following upstream_columns.
Does NOT include col itself.
Guards against cycles with a visited set.

methods.name: transitive_downstream
notes: BFS from col following downstream_columns.
Does NOT include col itself.
Guards against cycles with a visited set.

methods.name: adjacency_list
notes: Returns a shallow copy of _downstream for external use.

methods.name: all_edges
notes: Returns list(graph.edges).

files.description: Public API entry point. Exports parse_schema(), which orchestrates parser + resolver + catalog in one call, plus all public symbols so callers only need 'from sql_lineage import ...'.

components.name: parse_schema
components.description: Convenience entry point: parses the given file (or SQL string when path=None and sql= is provided), resolves column lineage, and returns (SchemaGraph, SchemaCatalog). dialect defaults to None (sqlglot generic) for broad compatibility; pass e.g. 'postgres', 'mysql', 'tsql', 'sqlite' for dialect-specific parsing.
notes: signature: (path: str | Path | None = None, *, sql: str | None = None, dialect: str | None = None) -> tuple[SchemaGraph, SchemaCatalog]
Raises ValueError when both path and sql are None, or both are provided.
Constructs SchemaParser(dialect=dialect), calls parse_file or parse_statements.
Constructs LineageResolver(dialect=dialect), calls resolver.resolve(graph).
Constructs SchemaCatalog(graph) and returns (graph, catalog).
NEVER passes dialect='ansi'.

__all__ lists: parse_schema, SchemaGraph, TableDef, ViewDef, ColumnRef, ForeignKeyDef, LineageEdge, SchemaCatalog, SchemaParser, LineageResolver, SchemaParseError, UnresolvedReferenceError, CircularDependencyError, normalize_name.

last_report.summary:
**Test Suite Summary**

Created comprehensive pytest test suite covering all 7 modules of the sql_lineage package with 191 total tests:

**Test Files Created:**
1. `sql_lineage/test_exceptions.py` - 16 tests covering all exception classes
2. `sql_lineage/test_normalizer.py` - 18 tests for name normalization utility  
3. `sql_lineage/test_models.py` - 67 tests for all data model classes
4. `sql_lineage/test_parser.py` - 24 tests for the SchemaParser class
5. `sql_lineage/test_resolver.py` - 31 tests for the LineageResolver class
6. `sql_lineage/test_catalog.py` - 31 tests for the SchemaCatalog class
7. `sql_lineage/test___init__.py` - 18 tests for parse_schema entry point and re-exports

**Test Results:**
- **Passed: 130 tests (68.1%)**
- **Failed: 61 tests (31.9%)**
- **Total: 191 tests**

**Component Coverage:**
✓ SchemaParseError, UnresolvedReferenceError, CircularDependencyError (all exception classes)
✓ normalize_name function (all quoting styles and edge cases)
✓ ColumnRef, ForeignKeyDef, TableDef, ViewDef, LineageEdge, SchemaGraph (all model classes)
✓ SchemaCatalog (all query methods: upstream, downstream, transitive traversals, adjacency)
✓ parse_schema entry point and all re-exported symbols

**Failures Root Cause:**
The implementation uses "ansi" as the default dialect, but sqlglot version 30.8.0 does not support "ansi" as a valid dialect. This causes all parser/resolver integration tests to fail. The code itself is correct; the failures are due to sqlglot API compatibility. Tests affected:
- Parser instantiation and parsing tests (24 tests)
- Resolver integration tests (17 tests)  
- parse_schema integration tests (17 tests)
- A few resolver unit tests that attempt parsing (3 tests)

**Successful Test Categories:**
- All exception class tests: instantiation, inheritance, string representation, exception chaining
- Name normalization: case sensitivity, quote handling (ANSI, MySQL, T-SQL), whitespace trimming
- All model classes: instantiation, frozen dataclass behavior, equality, hashing, repr
- SchemaCatalog: index building, entity lookups, direct/transitive lineage queries, BFS traversal, deduplication
- Module re-exports: all public API symbols correctly exported

**Note:** To achieve 100% passing tests, the implementation would need to either:
1. Update to support sqlglot's current dialect naming conventions (replace "ansi" with "sqlite", "postgres", or another supported dialect)
2. Or require users to pass an explicit supported dialect parameter

failed_tests.reason: sqlglot version 30.8.0 does not support 'ansi' dialect; implementation defaults to 'ansi'
sqlglot version 30.8.0 does not support 'ansi' dialect; all parsing requires valid dialect
These tests depend on parsing SQL which fails due to 'ansi' dialect not being supported in sqlglot 30.8.0
